ads.headline: Why some people drink iced water through a straw
ads.brief: Close-up of an ordinary person's hand holding a tall glass of iced water with a straw, on a cafe table in natural light. Real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube on the table beside the glass. Small supporting tagline beneath the headline: "It's not for the ice." This is a candid lifestyle usage photo, not a studio product shot.
ads.label: Sensitivity C1 — Iced Water Straw

ads.headline: Why some people warm their toothbrush under the hot tap
ads.brief: A toothbrush held under a running, steaming hot tap at a bathroom sink. The real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube standing on the sink edge. Small supporting tagline beneath the headline: "Cold water on sensitive teeth. Ouch." Candid bathroom usage photo, not a studio product shot.
ads.label: Sensitivity C2 — Hot Tap Toothbrush

ads.headline: Some people bite their ice cream. Some people lick it.
ads.brief: Split image, two ice cream cones. LEFT cone: perfectly round, only licked, with a large bold high-contrast label beneath it reading exactly "LICKERS" (not small print — same weight as a headline). RIGHT cone: an identical cone with a clean bite taken out of it, with an equally large bold high-contrast label beneath it reading exactly "BITERS". The real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube, small, bottom right corner only. Small supporting tagline beneath the headline: "The lickers usually have a reason." This is a graphic two-camp comparison concept, not a lifestyle photo.
ads.label: Sensitivity C3 — Bite vs Lick

ads.headline: grabbing drinks, what do u want? / lemonade, no ice pls / again?? it's 34 degrees
ads.brief: An iMessage chat screenshot showing this exact exchange: Friend: "grabbing drinks, what do u want?" Me: "lemonade, no ice pls" Friend: "again?? it's 34 degrees". Bottom band of the image: the real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube (German pack) photo.
ads.label: Sensitivity C4 — Text Thread

ads.headline: "Toothpaste works well with my tooth sensitivity issues." (Verified customer)
ads.brief: Real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube (German pack) on a clean background. Next to it, a review card styled like a verified review, with the quote on it, labelled "Verified customer". No star rating or name shown. Small supporting tagline beneath: "Individual experiences vary."
ads.label: Sensitivity C5 — Verified Review Card

ads.headline: The tube runs out. The "ouch" comes back.
ads.brief: A plain, unbranded toothpaste tube rolled all the way up to the last squeeze, lying next to a fresh, real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube (German pack). Clean bathroom bench. Small supporting tagline beneath: "That's the giveaway."
ads.label: Sensitivity C6 — Rolled Tube vs Fresh

ads.headline: 1,000,000,000+ LACALUT tubes sold
ads.brief: Hero shot of the real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube and box (German pack) on a clean neutral background. Big stat across the top from the headline, smaller supporting line under the product. Small supporting tagline beneath: "One German toothpaste. 60+ countries. Made since 1925."
ads.label: Sensitivity C7 — Stats Hero

ads.headline: Brushing hard, up and down?
ads.brief: Toothbrush on a plain background with big hand-drawn marker arrows going up and down, circled in red — playful, NOT anatomical or clinical styling. Real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube (German pack) bottom right. Small supporting tagline beneath: "Read this before tonight's brush."
ads.label: Sensitivity C8 — Diagram Arrows

ads.headline: It was never the ice cream.
ads.brief: Ice cream van menu board on a sunny day, hand-painted style text, showing the headline. Do NOT AI-generate the tube — composite the real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube (German pack) photo in the bottom corner. Small supporting tagline beneath: "It's not about the weather."
ads.label: Sensitivity C9 — Ice Cream Van Sign

ads.headline: MYTH: Sensitive teeth are an "older person" thing. FACT: It can show up at any adult age.
ads.brief: 2-panel card. Top panel, grey background: the MYTH line. Bottom panel, LACALUT colour background: the FACT line. Real LACALUT SENSITIVE tube (German pack) photo bottom right. Adults only in any imagery.
ads.label: Sensitivity C10 — Myth vs Fact
